decisions.reason: The Trivital supplement range builds on the firm's established pharmacy consumer-health business and had dedicated web presence through 2019, and it fits the strategy of broadening consumer health products, so an expanding firm with slack has no reason to drop it.
The skin and hair supplement extends the established Trivital brand at low incremental cost and had its own page in both years, and no shortfall signal is visible, so the firm keeps it.
Joint health is a stable pharmacy supplement category and the product moved from a mention to its own page, which suggests satisfactory results within the brand line.
Demand for immune supplements rose during the pandemic years, which likely lifted results above aspiration, and the product fits the range at low carrying cost.

The 2018 valsartan impurity recall was a clear shortfall and could prompt problemistic search, but it was industry-wide and blood pressure generics are a core volume market, so a large firm with slack would more likely re-source the active ingredient than exit.
An over-the-counter triptan is a differentiated pharmacy product that matches the strategy of expanding consumer health products, and it had its own page with no reported problems.
